description: The dish name leads AIREC-001's brief and is the one field the prompt treats as binding on every concept returned, which makes it the field an attacker would choose: an instruction written there is read as the subject the model is told to honour. It is still the creator's own words, so it travels inside the rendered brief in the fenced PREFERENCES segment and never reaches the system message. Structural containment only — it does not and cannot prove a model declines what it finds there. What bounds the answer if the model does obey is the output contract, which has no member for a safety claim.

input.task: Propose recipe concepts for a food content creator's next project.
